position_overview: Our client, a venture-backed AI startup in Sydney developing a mobile app in the pet space, is seeking an Executive Assistant to partner closely with the founder. This role combines traditional C-suite EA responsibilities with hands-on, tech-savvy operational support - helping the team move quickly, stay organized, and scale efficiently.
key_responsibilities:
Executive Support: Manage the founder’s calendar and inbox, coordinate travel, prepare meetings, take minutes, and ensure follow-ups are completed.

Operating Cadence: Oversee founder routines, facilitate OKR check-ins, manage weekly executive agendas, and track actions across teams.

Project Coordination: Drive small cross-functional projects, track milestones, and help unblock project owners to ensure timely delivery.

Research & Reporting: Conduct research, analyze data, and summarize key insights for decision-making.

Administrative Support: Handle documentation, follow-ups, and general administrative tasks.

Ad Hoc Tasks: Take on varied responsibilities as needed, including tasks outside prior experience.
qualifications:
3-7+ years of experience as an EA supporting C-level leaders in startups/tech or a tech-savvy operator from a startup/scale-up ready to implement gold-standard EA routines.

Mastery of calendar/email management, meeting preparation, and executive prioritization.

Excellent written communication, including concise note-taking and document creation.

Strong project management skills: ability to create clear plans, assign owners, define critical paths, and provide status updates.

CRM experience.

Excellent written and spoken English, fast learner, strong attention to detail.

Nice to have:

Basic Canva or design skills.

Basic video editing.

Genuine interest in pets and pet care.
